name: Alabama et al. v. North Carolina

court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

parties: Alabama et al. v. North Carolina.

opinions.text: Motion of the Special Master for allowance of fees and reimbursement of expenses granted, and the Special Master is awarded a total of $80,904.16 for the period November 1, 2006, through June 30, 2010, to be paid equally by the parties. Justice Kagan took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion. [For earlier order herein, see, e. g., 558 U. S. 1010.]
